facts.text: A Fire Nation ship is on the water when the iceberg's beam of light goes up. Zuko is the one standing on deck.

unlock.derived: The stage direction cuts from the iceberg's beam to a Fire Nation ship and the boy on deck.

facts.text: Zuko orders the helmsman to steer for that light. He says he needs to capture the Avatar.

unlock.derived: Zuko's line on the ship, after Iroh suggests the light might be nothing.

facts.text: Zhao later hires pirates to blow the ship up with blasting jelly. Zuko survives the blast. That is The Waterbending Master, not this episode.

unlock.derived: Avatar Wiki places the explosion in The Waterbending Master. This build has no transcript anchor there, so the fact stays locked until that episode is over.

facts.text: Aang introduces the sky bison as Appa, his flying bison.

unlock.derived: Aang's line after Appa wakes in the ice.

facts.text: Katara works out that Aang was in the ice for about a hundred years. Appa was in there with him.

unlock.derived: Katara asks how long he was in the iceberg, inside the abandoned ship.

facts.text: Katara's waterbending cracks a towering iceberg. A beam of light shoots out of it.

unlock.derived: The stage direction of the iceberg bursting and the beam of light.

facts.text: The boy from the ice says his name is Aang, once he is done sneezing.

unlock.derived: Aang's introduction on the ice.

facts.text: Aang enters the Avatar state at the Southern Water Tribe when Zuko comes back for him. That fight is the next episode.

unlock.derived: The Avatar Returns shows the Avatar state. No line anchor is bundled for that episode, so this stays locked until the episode is over.

facts.text: Getting dressed in the village, Aang's blue arrow tattoos show on his arms, legs, back, and head.

unlock.derived: The stage direction in the tent, before he meets the village.

facts.text: Katara says she is the only waterbender in the whole South Pole.

unlock.derived: Her line while she and Aang are with the penguins.

facts.text: The blue pendant is a betrothal necklace that belonged to Katara's mother. The show explains that when it is stolen, in The Waterbending Scroll.

unlock.derived: The pilot transcript never mentions the necklace. The mother's story is a later episode, so it stays locked until The Waterbending Scroll is over.

facts.text: Sokka is out in the canoe with Katara, trying to spear a fish and telling her to watch how it is done.

unlock.derived: Sokka's first spoken line on the water.

facts.text: In the village, Sokka sits by the tent sharpening his boomerang while Aang is pulled out to meet everyone.

unlock.derived: The stage direction in the tent names the boomerang.

facts.text: Katara walks Aang out and tells him this gathering is the entire village.

unlock.derived: Katara's line introducing the village.

facts.text: The elder who steps forward is Katara and Sokka's grandmother. She tells Aang to call her Gran-Gran.

unlock.derived: Kanna's introduction.

facts.text: Katara says the stranded Fire Navy ship has haunted the tribe since Gran-Gran was a little girl. It was part of the Fire Nation's first attacks.

unlock.derived: Katara's line inside the wreck.

facts.text: Aang trips a wire. The wreck's machinery spins up and fires a flare into the sky.

unlock.derived: The stage direction of the flare leaving the shipwreck.

facts.text: Watching through a telescope, Zuko calls the boy the last airbender and says he has found the Avatar, and the hiding place.

unlock.derived: Zuko's last line of the episode.

facts.text: Iroh is on the ship with Zuko. He treats the light as something they have chased before and tells Zuko not to get excited over nothing.

unlock.derived: Iroh's line about the celestial lights, before Zuko turns the ship.

facts.text: The reason Zuko was banished, and why capturing the Avatar would restore his place, is told in The Storm.

unlock.derived: The Storm is the episode that tells the banishment. Locked until that episode is over so the pilot does not spoil it.
